g.text: SIF-101 H-101 PASS 1 LOW-LOW FLOW (2OO3) -> FUEL SSOVS
24 VDC loop powered from I/O card (2-wire)
24 VDC loop powered from I/O card (2-wire)
24 VDC loop powered from I/O card (2-wire)
24 VDC SOV from SIS DO card (line-monitored)
24 VDC SOV from SIS DO card (line-monitored)
NAMUR / dry contact to SIS DI

Trip SP: 40 % of design pass flow
1. SIL 2 per LOPA (CFU-000-IC-RPT-002). 2oo3 voting with 2oo2 on one transmitter in bypass / fault; deviation alarm between A/B/C (5 %).
2. Final elements: XV-1021 and XV-1022 in series (1oo2) with vent XV-1230 (double block & bleed); also pilot XV-1026 (SIF-101 / BMS). Proof-test interval 12 months (partial stroke 3 months).
3. Field cables and JBs for SIS are segregated (red sheath / labels); SIS multicores separate from DCS.
